```renyi
module passwords

public type Strength is one of
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Classify a password by length and character variety.
  example: classify(password: "abc") is Weak
  example: classify(password: "abcdefgh") is Fair
  example: classify(password: "Abcdef12!") is Fair
  example: classify(password: "Abcdef12!xyz") is Strong

  if password.length is less than 8 then
    return Weak
  otherwise if password.length is less than 12 then
    return Fair
  otherwise if password.matches(raw ".*[A-Za-z].*") and password.matches(raw ".*[0-9].*") and password.matches(raw ".*[^A-Za-z0-9].*") then
    return Strong
  otherwise
    return Fair
  end
end
```
